$comment: Per-repo config for THIS repo's own ratcheted PR/push source-leak run (self-source-leak-gate.yml passes it via the reusable gate's `config` input; consuming repos never receive it). ONE exemption class, the same self-referential false positive config/self-check.json documents at length: files that must carry a gate's OWN literal name, which the SLG_PLANNING_DOC rule reads as a planning-artifact marker. skills-drift-gate.yml is the gate's own reusable workflow — its steps invoke scripts out of the gate checkout directory named after the gate, an irreducible reference (all rephraseable prose mentions on changed lines are reworded instead, per the rephrase-first doctrine). self-check.json is the hermetic self-check's exemption ledger — its entries LIST such gate filenames verbatim, so any edit to the ledger line would otherwise trip the ratchet that this config exists to calibrate. This file itself is self-exempt (the engine exempts the --config path). The parity fixture corpus is skipped by prefix and lines marked source-leak-allow are exempt: planted detector test input and the engine's own rationale comments must be able to carry the phrasings the gate bans. Engine+test pair exemption: source-leak-gate.mjs, source-leak-gate.test.mjs and source-leak.fixture.txt carry the private names AS THE RULE SET and its deliberate test inputs (the same class as the other engine+test pairs the org exempts); nothing else is exempted.
